newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi index falls in low trading.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi index falls in low trading.

text.p: The Nairobi bourse 20-share index and turnover fell on Wednesday in a session that saw low activity with no special news to excite trading, brokers said.
The index fell 24.93 points to 3053.12 while turnover was 6.430 million shillings on 208,703 shares from 11.477 million shillings on 375,517 shares on Tuesday.
Kenya Airways traded 36,426 shares at 10.10, 9.80 and 9.90 from 10 while Uchumi Supermarket fell 50 cents to 38.50.
Barclays Bank fell 2.0 shillings to 99, Kenya Commercial Bank eased to 52 from 52.50 and Standard Chartered fell to 43.25 from 44.25.
A bourse official said foreign investors dealt 9,742 shares of Kenya Breweries at 46. Kenya Power & Lighting fell 3.0 shillings to 117 and British American Tobacco eased to 62.50 from 65.
